allowothertargets.default: if this.ship.isplayerowned then false else true

checkrelation.default: if ($primarytarget and this.ship.isplayerowned) then this.ship.mayattack.{$primarytarget} else true

enforceradius.default: if this.ship.isplayerowned then true else false

pursuetargets.default: if this.ship.isplayerowned then true else false

pursuedistance.default: if ((this.ship.assignment == assignment.defence) and this.ship.isplayerowned) then 20km else [@$target.maxradarrange, this.ship.maxradarrange, 1km].max
